rows.title_full: AN ACT GRANTING THE DISABLED PERSON THE SAME PRIVILEGES ENJOYED BY SENIOR CITIZENS, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE THE MAGNA CARTA FOR DISABLED PERSONS
rows.abstract: Seeks to grant the disabled person the following privileges enjoyed by senior citizens:  (1) 20% discount from hotels, restaurants, recreation centers and or purchase of medicines and transportaion; (2) exemption for the individual income tax; and (3) full medical and dental services in government establishment. rows.title_full: AN ACT REVISING THE FORM OF EXCISE TAX ON FERMENTED LIQUOR FROM AD VALOREM TO SPECIFIC, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE SECTION 140 OF THE NATIONAL INTERNAL REVENUE CODE, AS AMENDED
rows.abstract: Fixes a SPECIFIC TAX on fermented liquor according to the following schedule; (1) P8.00/liter - beer worth P26.00/liter and above; (2) P6.00/liter - beer costing below P26.00/liter.
rows.status: Substituted by HB07198

rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING ARTICLE 95 OF PRESIDENTIAL DECREE NO. 442, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE LABOR CODE OF THE PHILIPPINES, TO PROMOTE WORKERS' RIGHT TO REST AND SAFEGUARD THEIR HEALTH AND WELFARE
rows.abstract: Refers to an employee's [Right to service incentive leave] RIGHT TO PAID LEAVES OF ABSENCE; entitles the employee who has rendered AT LEAST SIX (6) months of service to a yearly VACATION LEAVE OF FIFTEEN (15) DAYS WITH PAY AND A YEARLY SICK LEAVE OFFIFTEEN (15) DAYS WITH PAY.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LABOR AND EMPLOYMENT since 1995-11-06

rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING CERTAIN PROVISIONS OF PRESIDENTIAL DECREE NO. 442, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE LABOR CODE OF THE PHILIPPINES, TO INSTITUTIONALIZ E SUNDAYS AS REST DAYS OF EMPLOYEES AND PRESCRIBE PREMIUMS ON WORK DONE ON REST DAYS AND HOLIDAYS
rows.abstract: Seeks to reinstate the spirit and principle behind RA 946 by insatitutionali zing SUNDAYS AS REST DAYS of employees; recognizes theFAMILY as the foundation of the nation.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LABOR AND EMPLOYMENT since 1995-11-06

rows.title_full: AN ACT TO FURTHER STRENGTHEN THE PROVISION ON A JUDGMENT MANDATING IMMEDIATE REINSTATEMENT OF WORKERS, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE ARTICLE 223 OF THE LABOR CODE OF THE PHILIPPINES, AS AMENDED
rows.abstract: Requires the labor arbiter to incorporate in his judgment of reinstatement the issuance of the corresponding writ of execution.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LABOR AND EMPLOYMENT since 1995-11-06

rows.title_full: AN ACT INSTITUTING INCOME SECURITY FOR WORKERS BY PROVIDING THEM UNEMPLOYMENT BENEFITS IN CASE OF INVOLUNTARY UNEMPLOYMENT CONTINGENCIES AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Declares that any worker who suffers involuntary unemployment due to retrenchment, shutdown, merger, closure, etc. shall be entitled to a MONTHLY UNEMPLOYMENT INSURANCE BENEFIT equivalent to his current basic monthly salary to a maximum period of six (6) months. Prescribes penalty for violation of this Act.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LABOR AND EMPLOYMENT since 1995-11-06

rows.title_full: AN ACT STRENGTHENING THE WORKERS' RIGHT TO COLLECTIVE BARGAINING AGREEMENTS BY AMENDING ARTICLE 253-A OF PRESIDENTIAL DECREE NO. 442, AS AMENDED, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE LABOR CODE OF THE PHILIPPINES
rows.abstract: States that any collective bargaining agreement shall be for a term of [five (5)] THREE (3) years.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LABOR AND EMPLOYMENT since 1995-11-06

rows.author: A060
rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING POLICE FORCES UNDER  THE ADMINISTRATIVE AND OPERATIONAL CONTROL OF THE LOCAL GOVERNMENT EXECUTIVES, AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract: "Police Act of 1995" Intends to give back to the local government executives the control of the police; provides for significant areas of concern, such as: (1) constitution of city or municipal police force; (2) duties of peace officers; (3) qualifications for appointment; (4) Police Disciplinary Board, etc.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on PUBLIC ORDER AND SECURITY since 1995-11-06

rows.title_full: AN ACT TO PRIORITIZE THE DEVELOPMENT OF MASS, SOCIALIZED AND LOW COST HOUSING AS ONE OF THE MAIN OBJECTIVES OF THE DEVELOPMENT BANK OF THE PHILIPPINES, AMENDING THEREBY EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 81 AS AMENDED, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE 1986 REVISED CHARTER OF THE DEVELOPMENT BANK OF THE PHILIPPINES
rows.abstract: Empowers the DBP to grant loans to homebuyers, real estate developers, homeowners, cooperative associations or corporations for land acquisition and development; mandate the DBP to engage in landbanking activities.
